reachable_set_diff.why_this_matters: the reachable file set is derived from emitted symbol names via map_reachable_files (consumer_closure.py:3156-3176). A rebuild that inlines or de-duplicates a function changes which file a reachable address is attributed to, and can remove a file from the set with no change to any call edge in the source. The counts 319/309/169 and 312/302/146 are therefore not a like-for-like measurement of the same call graph.

verdict.label: VERIFIER_DEFECT
verdict.statement: None of the nine sites is an export-reachable callback with an unbounded target set. The field they call is written only by the two in-image method-store writers, and the values written are a finite in-image set of fourteen destructors. The FAIL is produced by the resolver's target list being a list of emitted symbol names: the one name that mattered ('free_decoder') was a compiler-inlined wrapper that this rebuild stopped emitting, so the whole spec was discarded. The v1h PASS was correct for the v1h image (that image really did store the wrapper at 0x4fdc10), which is exactly the problem: the evidence was bound to an emitted symbol, not to the semantic target.
what_is_not_claimed: This does not make element 7 pass. The recorded verdict remains FAIL, and the recorded counts are unchanged.
The counterfactual in control 2 is unsound as a repair: its 13-element set omits OSSL_DECODER_free, which this image stores.
The v1h PASS is not reusable as evidence for any other image.
verdict.safe_compatible_distance: further than the deltas suggested. Beyond the four standing refusals (STALE_HASH, MISSING_BOUNDARY_RECEIPT, UNKNOWN_OBLIGATION, UNKNOWN_MECHANISM), two of the three numbers the campaign has been trending (reachable files and obligations) are shown here to move under a one-file rebuild with no source-level call-graph change, so a comparison of 169 -> 146 is not a measurement of progress.

fix_required.primary: Derive a slot's target set from the values actually stored into it by reachable code, not from a hand-maintained list of emitted symbol names. Concretely: resolve the sixth argument of ossl_method_store_add and the corresponding argument of ossl_method_store_cache_set at every reachable call site through the GOT relocation or materialisation that produced it; normalise thunk-equivalence (a one-line wrapper and its callee are the same semantic target); and treat 'this declared name is absent from the image' as evidence of a smaller set, never as a reason to discard the whole spec. _fragment_addrs must return the resolvable subset plus the absent fragments, not None.
fix_required.secondary: Add a reachability-stability control at BATCH level: rebuild the same frozen candidate and require the reachable file/function sets to be identical, or refuse the closure. A conservative upper bound must not shrink when a one-file change adds calls; the current 13-file loss on a 4-line semantic change cannot be explained by the source, and the evidence closure is not trustworthy until it can be.
fix_required.property_that_must_hold: for any element-7 PASS, the target set recorded at each reachable unresolved site must be a function of the frozen source candidate and its semantic call graph, not of which symbols this particular link happened to emit.

non_claims: This is not an independent review; the author of the explanation is the author of the instrumentation.
It does not change any recorded classification or count in openssh-closure-v1j.json; element 7 remains FAIL for both consumers.
It does not prove the reachable-set instability is only symbol emission; that the 19-file change is unexplained is established, the precise mechanism inside LLVM/lld is not.

It does not establish that the 14-value target set is complete for all reachable code; the store enumeration covers every store to a 0x20 displacement in the image, but only the two writers are claimed as writers, and the EVP half is verified by sampling (EVP_CIPHER_free, EVP_MD_free) plus the resolver's own target list.
The loader/decoder/encoder values arrive through GLOB_DAT slots; the set is finite for these consumers but is not a link-time bound in general.
No rebuild-determinism check, no Miri/ASan/Loom run, and no independent adjudication was performed at this identity.
